main.description: Identifies the subject a site.standard.document is about. Placed in the document's links open union. The presence of this object is what marks a document as one of ours.

title.description: The subject's name, as the author gives it.

externalUrls.description: Places to read more about the subject, in the author's preferred order.

service.description: Service this URL points at. Consumers dispatch service-specific rendering on an exact match against knownValues. Values outside knownValues belong to the authoring client's own vocabulary and MUST be preserved on rewrite and rendered as a plain link.
